# awscc_sagemaker_endpoint_policy (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::SageMaker::EndpointPolicy. Attaches a resource policy to a SageMaker endpoint. The policy grants other AWS accounts access to the endpoint, for example through a SageMaker Inference Router. An endpoint has at most one resource policy, which is removed when the endpoint is deleted.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the endpoint the policy is attached to. The endpoint must be in the same account and Region as the stack.
- `policy_document` (String) The resource policy document, as a JSON object. The service returns the document in its canonical form, so specify principals as full ARNs (for example arn:aws:iam::111122223333:root) and keep the form the service returns, to avoid drift.

### Read-Only

- `endpoint_name` (String) The name of the endpoint the policy is attached to.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_sagemaker_endpoint_policy.example
  identity = {
    endpoint_arn = "endpoint_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `endpoint_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the endpoint the policy is attached to

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_sagemaker_endpoint_policy.example
  id = "endpoint_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_sagemaker_endpoint_policy.example "endpoint_arn"
```
